config.label: Personal API key from anyhook
config.description: Personal API key from anyhook.net/dashboard/settings/api-keys. Starts with ahk_live_. Optional: without it, the anyhook_quickstart tool can self-provision an account, or tools run against an in-memory store for local dev.

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://anyhook.net. Used by self-hosted AnyHook installations.
